label: AI Travel Agent
description: An AI travel agent that books flights by voice, rebooks them when they are delayed, and splits the bill between travelers — with built-in Stripe-backed subscription tiers

APP_URL.description: Public URL of the app, used in the pay links texted to travelers

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Anthropic API key for the agent

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: OpenAI API key for Whisper speech-to-text and text-to-speech

ELEVENLABS_API_KEY.description: ElevenLabs API key for optional voices

AMADEUS_CLIENT_ID.description: Amadeus API key for live flight search; without it the seeded inventory is used

TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID.description: Twilio account SID for rebooking texts and pay links; without it texts are captured, not sent

TWILIO_FROM_NUMBER.description: Twilio sender number in E.164 format

STRIPE_SECRET_KEY.description: Stripe secret API key (sk_test_... in test mode)

STRIPE_AI_TRAVEL_AGENT_PRO_MONTHLY.description: Stripe price ID for the Pro Monthly plan

STRIPE_AI_TRAVEL_AGENT_PRO_YEARLY.description: Stripe price ID for the Pro Yearly plan

STRIPE_AI_TRAVEL_AGENT_TEAM_MONTHLY.description: Stripe price ID for the Team Monthly plan

STRIPE_AI_TRAVEL_AGENT_TEAM_YEARLY.description: Stripe price ID for the Team Yearly plan

MAILGUN_API_KEY.description: Mailgun API key for transactional emails
